Develop advanced Deluge scripts and custom functions to extend both platforms, automate complex business logic, and integrate with third-party systems. Build custom widgets and UI components using Deluge to enhance sales dashboards, customer portals, and support agent interfaces. Create sophisticated automation workflows combining Deluge scripting with pipeline management and customer support operations. Implement AI-powered capabilities using Zohos AI offerings and external AI services. Manage data migrations, synchronisation, cleansing, deduplication, and governance activities. Integrate agent-based AI architectures and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers with Deluge-powered custom logic for intelligent automation. Manage seamless data synchronisation and integrations between Zoho CRM, Zoho Desk, and external systems using Deluge APIs, webhooks, and custom connectors. Collaborate with Sales, Support, Operations, and Product teams to translate business requirements into integrated, intelligent Zoho solutions. Write clean, maintainable, well-documented Deluge code following best practices and coding standards. Build custom functions for lead scoring, deal management, ticket processing, routing logic, data transformations. Custom Widget UI Development Design and develop custom widgets using Zoho Widget Framework and Deluge to enhance CRM and Desk interfaces. Build interactive sales dashboards, agent consoles, customer portals, and management views with custom widgets. Integrate widgets with AI models and data services to display AI-powered insights, recommendations, and analytics. Customise page layouts, views, and configurations across both platforms to align with business workflows. Design CRM Canvas experiences, widgets, kiosks, and forms that create efficient user journeys across CRM and support processes. Zoho CRM Configuration Configure and manage Zoho CRM modules, fields, layouts, workflows, approvals, blueprints, assignment rules, notifications, views, page layouts, and pipeline workflows. Implement sales automation, lead management, deal tracking, and forecasting capabilities aligned with strategy. Design and optimise Zoho CRM dashboards and reports for team performance monitoring and pipeline visibility. Develop reports, dashboards, KPIs, analytical data models, and where required, SQL queries to support operational visibility and business decision-making. Zoho Desk Configuration Support Operations Configure and manage Zoho Desk modules, channels, workflows, and SLAs for multi-channel support operations. Implement email, chat, phone, social media, and portal integrations for seamless customer service. Design and optimise Zoho Desk dashboards for support team performance monitoring and KPI tracking. AI-Powered Sales Customer Service Implement AI capabilities in Zoho CRM: AI lead scoring, sales predictions, opportunity recommendations, and AI-assisted deal closure. Deploy AI features in Zoho Desk: AI-powered ticket routing, categorisation, sentiment analysis, and agent recommendations. Build AI chatbots and virtual agents for lead qualification, customer support, and self-service using Deluge logic. Explore and implement agent-based AI architectures, MCP servers, and AI orchestration frameworks across both platforms. Advanced Automation Workflows Design and implement sophisticated automation rules, workflows, and SLAs using Deluge for complex sales and support logic. Build intelligent escalation logic, conditional routing, and AI-triggered workflows across CRM and Desk. Optimise Deluge scripts and workflows for performance, maintainability, and reliability. CRM Desk Integration Data Synchronisation Design and implement seamless bi-directional synchronisation between Zoho CRM and Desk for unified customer view. Develop custom APIs, webhooks, and Deluge connectors to integrate with third-party systems and AI services. Connect Zoho applications with operational systems and external services, including API mapping, authentication, monitoring, and error handling. Ensure reliable, secure integrations with proper authentication, error handling, and performance optimisation. Maintain solution designs, configuration records, integration specifications, data dictionaries, and support runbooks to enable reliable delivery and operational support. Data Management Manage data quality, integrity, and migrations across Zoho CRM and Desk using Deluge data processing and ETL scripts. Perform data mapping, transformation, imports, record updates, deduplication, validation, profiling, reconciliation, cleansing, duplicate identification, and ongoing data quality rule implementation. Build data pipelines to feed AI models with quality sales and support data for insights, predictions, and recommendations. Monitor Zoho Desk and CRM performance, Deluge execution times, widget rendering, and system reliability.

Expert-level proficiency in Deluge scripting language with hands-on experience building complex business logic. Deep expertise in Zoho CRM configuration: modules, fields, workflows, automations, sales pipelines, and dashboards. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, code quality focus, and ability to work independently and in teams.
